milestone: M6 successor #2587 — live prose citation contracts

findings.summary: The initial gate's hand-maintained subject and locality lists silently ignored live Markdown and broken citations under repository-owned roots outside its selected docs and prefix set.
evidence: Verification: initial commit 56a1dde200d36e36d0db015084183a92954fd7f8, scripts/check-prose-citations.py:26-34 and :74-100 limited subjects to docs/** and locality to LOCAL_PREFIXES.

Verification: `python3 scripts/check-prose-citations.py --root /tmp/prose-probe.SGHS2S` at the initial commit exited 0 and examined only scripts/live.py:1 while the same tracked live Markdown cited missing `.fsgg/removed.yml:1`.

Verification: `gh issue view 2587 --repo FS-GG/.github --json body` AC1 requires a gate over repo-local path:line citations in tracked prose, and the issue's measured corpus was every tracked Markdown file.
resolution_evidence: Verification: final commit 5fa82dfddf85025bb93245d392e2d9598f250deb derives owned roots and src namespaces from `git ls-files`, selects every tracked nonhistorical Markdown file, and runs the workflow without path filters; see scripts/check-prose-citations.py:25-111 and .github/workflows/prose-citations.yml:1-56.

Verification: `bash tests/prose-citations/run.sh` at final commit passed 8/8, including the exact outside-docs `.fsgg/removed.yml:1` escape; `python3 scripts/check-prose-citations.py --root .` passed over 396 live Markdown documents and 73 local citations.
Verification: `bash tests/paths-coherence/run.sh` at final commit passed 72/72, including the shipped workflow closure checks.

findings.summary: The initial ADR assigned issue and pull-request body claims to an equivalent review-time control that the operational review contract did not contain.
evidence: Verification: initial commit 56a1dde200d36e36d0db015084183a92954fd7f8, docs/adr/0074-live-prose-citations-are-local-file-contracts.md:33-39 required repository/revision and command-or-check provenance for remote body claims, but the diff made no corresponding operational review-guidance change.

Verification: `rg -n 'path:line|suite[- ]green|suite is green|repository/revision' .agents/skills .claude/skills docs/coordination policy profile` at the initial commit found only generic handoff provenance; .agents/skills/pnext-item/references/independent-review.md:332-344 allowed a file:line basis without the ADR's body-specific repository/revision or count/suite command rule.

Verification: `gh issue view 2587 --repo FS-GG/.github --json body` AC3 requires the implementation to state where the equivalent issue/PR-body check lives when remote bodies are outside the static gate.
resolution_evidence: Verification: final commit 5fa82dfddf85025bb93245d392e2d9598f250deb adds the issue-and-pull-request body evidence rule to both packed pnext-item independent-review roots, requiring repository/revision or stable URL for cross-repository citations, command/check provenance for counts and suite verdicts, and excluding unverified claims from acceptance evidence.

Verification: `bash tests/skill-quality/run.sh` at final commit passed the live semantic/projection checks and all 46 rejection cases, proving both runtime projections agree and the packed protocol remains valid.

Verification: `bash tests/kit-package/run.sh`, `bash tests/kit-published-coherence/run.sh`, `bash tests/coherent-set-version/run.sh`, and `bash tests/engine-release-notes/run.sh` at final commit passed 16/16, 181/181, 13/13, and 25/25 respectively; coherent version 0.57.0 and its release rationale/notes cover the receiver-visible review protocol change.
